messages:
Alex Chen: Weekly account health check-in — token usage & throughput (QoQ/WoW). TL;DR: tokens -8% WoW, +13% QoQ; p95 latency +60ms WoW; error rate 0.6% but spike to 2.1% on Wed (model fallback/503s); spend +2% MoM. Onboarding cohort B still behind (missing prompt templates). Need ops + enablement coordination.
Mira Patel: Can you drop a per-route breakdown? keen to see /chat vs /embeddings and any customer-specific spikes.
Alex Chen: Quick breakdown: /chat: tokens -10% WoW, throughput steady. /embed: tokens +22% QoQ, bursty sessions (short high-concurrency windows). Per-account pinch: Halcyon drove the Wed spike. Chart: https://rdw.in/internal/metrics/241789 (internal).
CJ: I looked at infra logs — saw repeated `fallback -> 503` entries around 14:12 Wed. Snippet: `2026-03-18T14:12:03Z engine: fallback triggered model=bloom-6b status=503 batch_size=48 account=halcyon` — likely transient GPU OOM when large batch hit dedicated pool.
Sam R: Halcyon renewal in ~8w. This error spike is a renewal risk if we don't show remediation. I'll own outreach. @Mira can you prepare a 20–30 min ops+prompt playbook for them?
Mira Patel: Will do. Plan: short playbook + 3 prioritized prompts tuned for prefix caching + a checklist for KV cache TTL tuning. ETA: EOD Thu. Also recommend a 30-min enablement call with their infra.
Alex Chen: Next steps summary: (1) CJ validate and deploy fallback patch + autoscale tune; (2) Mira deliver playbook + sample prompts; (3) Sam schedule customer touchpoint and request sample dataset for demos; (4) CS to prepare renewal slide with QoQ token trends and spend.
CJ: Patch validated in staging this morning. Perf test showed reduced 503s when we increase `kv_cache_ttl` from 30s -> 120s for Halcyon test run. Command used: `./run_perf --account halcyon --kv-ttl 120` — recommend a short A/B rollout.
cs-bot: Weekly digest ready: https://rdw.in/cs-digests/2417890123 — includes token/time-series, p95 latency, error-rate events, and spend breakdown. :bell:
Sam R: I'll book the enablement for next Tue and ask Halcyon for a small sample dataset so we can demo prefix caching wins. Also pushing a billing summary to finance lead showing +2% MoM and the projected adjust if KV TTL increased.
Alex Chen: On renewal incentives: propose offering a 10% credit if we hit <1% error-rate SLA for next quarter. Thoughts?
Mira Patel: 10% seems reasonable if engineering signs off on mitigation steps and we document runbook.
CJ: OK from eng, provided we commit to autoscale policy changes and monitor for OOMs. I'll open a changelist (P1) and tag on-call for the initial rollout window.
Sam R: Capturing feedback: Halcyon asked for more deterministic reranker outputs and clearer cost breakdown per route. I'll include both in the enablement.
Alex Chen: Good. I'll attach the QoQ slides to the renewal pack and link this thread. Adding these action items to CS tracker. :white_check_mark:
Mira Patel: Any blockers for playbook? Need the sample dataset + confirmation of enablement time from Sam.
Sam R: I'll request the dataset in the outreach now.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — tracking OK. Will update this thread after the A/B rollout and after enablement.
